recordType: Parent summary of source review findings
scope: Read-only advisory source preparation; not a design vote, implementation acceptance or public transaction admission.

findings.claim: The unshielded token tutorial authenticates secret knowledge with persistentHash. ownPublicKey is prover claimed and does not establish authorization. The tutorial mint entry needs an explicit one-shot initialization guard for this campaign.

Private arguments and witnesses are available, but witness values are untrusted. Authorization must constrain the secret or signature, not accept an authorized boolean. Constructor bindings can be sealed.

The inspected unshielded receive API has no payer address predicate. Signed offers and UTXO inputs support receipt-level payer attribution. Balance queries describe entry balances, not balances after intra-call mint, receive or send.
sources: MC02 installed ledger-v8 type declarations and retained standard library exports

findings.claim: Choose role authorization and enrollment, bind recoverable capabilities to payout ownership, and explicitly distinguish receipt-level payer attribution from contract-enforced payer identity.

Role secrets checked by persistentHash can support a bounded local harness with constructor-bound roles and payout addresses. This requires explicit trusted enrollment and recoverable secret custody; no choice is accepted by this source review.
Action-specific in-circuit signatures require a separately verified compatibility path. Inspected Schnorr documentation and installed helper surfaces do not yet establish a complete signing route.

Reject wrong secrets, forged witness authorization, repeat initialization, wrong action or state revision, wrong recipient or token units, missing funding, insufficient entry reserves, hidden gross movement, and misclassification of third-party funding as borrower debit. Check financial rollback separately from fees.

nextStep: Prepare the consequential custody/authorization decision for Fable 5.1 medium, GPT-6 and Grok 4.6 high. Two substantive agreeing votes decide under the user instruction. No decision vote or provider dispatch has occurred for this proposal.
